provenance.method: One-time extraction of historical successful cases, with explicit reviewed corrections. No current resolver was used to produce expected answers.

corrections.confirmed_middle_name: Include the confirmed middle name in the full identity.
corrections.separate_sponsorship_scope_missing: An undifferentiated sponsorship boolean cannot determine now-only or future-only questions.
corrections.legal_option_topic: Authorization questions cannot select an option asserting sponsorship.
